basic_info.description: Located in a quiet neighborhood, on the edge of Mission Terrace and the Outer Mission, just two blocks from Balboa Park Bart & Muni Station. This reimagined two bedroom, one bath, single family home is move-in ready for its new owner! This sun-filled home has just undergone a full renovation including a new electrical system, kitchen & bath, recessed lighting, engineered hardwood floors, and full exterior and interior paint with resurfaced interior walls. The kitchen features all new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The bedrooms are very generous and also offer large closets. This home also offers five car parking including a deep two car side by side driveway and a huge garage screaming expansion potential. Two independent side by side garage doors offer an additional three parking spaces and space for laundry and a workshop. This property also features a spacious low maintenance backyard. Don't miss your chance at this stunning opportunity!
